## CLAIM_VS_REALITY_GAP

The central certificate claim is still mathematically false: top-K beam enumeration cannot upper-bound total unsafe probability without accounting for pruned and unexplored mass. The engineered equal-mass mock makes `upper_bound == empirical_rate`, concealing rather than validating that defect.
